decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship product line and builds directly on its core GIS engineering knowledge, reusable architectures and standards work, so the firm is well placed to interpret its results and keep improving it.

Mobile field data capture extends the firm's established GIS and app development expertise and fits its customers' operational processes, though the gap in website evidence after 2019 and the earlier withdrawal of the mobile layer component suggest some risk.

The search extension was still being versioned in 2019 and sits close to the firm's core map.apps knowledge, but small plugins of this kind were pruned earlier and may be merged into the platform, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
